purpose: speed-only; single64MiB, batch64MiB, rolling96MiB; six blocks; byte-verified results; no pooling with latency154

variants.next-opt: recovery-aware two-lane adaptive Next, no prefix/budget
variants.tuic: CatNode V2Core TUIC v5, explicit server BBR and client BBR; zero RTT and fast-open off

port_crossover: blocks 1/3/5: Next19458 TUIC19451; blocks2/4/6 swap ports; all 6 orders once per primary metric
readiness: mixed and web wait for each background to receive 256KiB, maximum 5 seconds
scope: Android native core CLI over Wi-Fi; formal App VPN temporarily off; no production changes; certificates verified
notes: End-to-end firstbyte includes proxy/target TLS/HTTP, not ping
Cold creates new client; warm reuses entry but creates target TLS each request
No packet-level or lane JSON trace during performance
TUIC native pool vs Next1/2 lanes: not an equal-connection-count algorithm experiment
Echo is simultaneous bidirectional echo, not pure upload
No post-hoc removal of slow or incomplete cases
